grammarFocus: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has。
title: My Family and Our Things
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的阅读练习。请先阅读短文，然后回答问题。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。注意：本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
A. My name is Li Hua. I have a small family. We are four people: my father, my mother, my sister, and me. We live in a small house in Beijing.

B. My father is a teacher. He has two books. My mother is a nurse. She has a white coat. My sister is a student. She has three pens. I have a red bag. We have a cat. Its name is Mimi. Mimi has four toys.

C. We are happy. We love our family.

questions.explanation: 原文说“We are four people”，所以是四口人。
questions.evidence: We are four people: my father, my mother, my sister, and me.

questions.explanation: 原文说“He has two books.”，所以爸爸有两本书。
原文说“She has a white coat.”，所以妈妈有一件白外套。
原文说“She has three pens.”，所以妹妹有三支笔。
原文说“I have a red bag.”，所以李华有一个红书包。
原文说“Its name is Mimi.”，所以猫的名字是Mimi。

questions.prompt: 猫有几个玩具？请用数字填空。
questions.explanation: 原文说“Mimi has four toys.”，所以猫有四个玩具。

questions.prompt: 李华一家住在哪里？请填一个词。
questions.explanation: 原文说“We live in a small house in Beijing.”，所以住在北京。
questions.evidence: We live in a small house in Beijing.

grammar.title: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，我们用“we”表示“我们”，“they”表示“他们”。动词“are”与we/they连用。名词复数一般加-s，如books, pens。物主代词my（我的）、your（你的）、his（他的）、her（她的）放在名词前。动词have表示“有”，当主语是he/she/it时用has。
grammar.example: We are four people. He has two books. She has three pens.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：___ are students.
questions.explanation: 主语是we，表示“我们”，所以用We。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：She ___ a white coat.
questions.explanation: 主语是she，第三人称单数，动词用has。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：I have two ___.
选择正确的单词填空：This is my sister. ___ name is Lily.
questions.explanation: sister是女性，所以用Her表示“她的”。
